title: fix(roman): gym talk is not sent to 911; crisis section in the client reply contract (AUDIT-05-125, T4)
body:
**Tier:** T4 (AI safety: crisis routing and the Roman client system prompt)
**Why:** AUDIT-05-125 (agent 125). The job says crisis routing must catch a real crisis and must NOT send ordinary gym talk to emergency copy. Two ordinary phrasings got the fixed "Please stop what you are doing and call 911 now" reply, and the client prompt said nothing about a crisis message that the deterministic router does not match.
**T4 trigger scan:** safety and crisis routing (yes). No auth, RLS/tenancy, PII, money, credentials or destructive data. No schema, migration, flag or dependency change.
**T3 trigger scan:** prompt contract text changes (PROMPT_VERSION roman-client-v3 -> roman-client-v4, logged per turn). No API contract change.
**Bounded T1:** n/a.
**Canonical builder:** Claude Opus 5.5 (AUDIT-05-125).
**Acceptance evidence:** `test/crisis-router-gym-talk-125.spec.ts` (25 cases) fails on main and passes here. Run locally and passing at this head, one file at a time: the new spec, `test/crisis-router-not-breathing.spec.ts` (73), `test/crisis-router-gym-talk.spec.ts` (122), `test/ai-crisis-router.spec.ts` (50), `test/roman/roman-guardrails.spec.ts` (25). The rest of the suite runs in this PR's CI.

## Fixes
- **B1 (AUDIT-05-125):** a client who tells Roman (or the AI guide) "I felt like I was going to pass out in the HIIT class" or "I was about to faint at the end of the run" gets "call 911 now" instead of an answer. A past near-faint (`was|were` before "going to / about to / gonna") is now history: Roman answers it through the model with the medical hint and the physician line (`pass out` / `black out` added to the existing near-miss medical-scope pattern). "I'm about to pass out", "I feel like I'm going to faint" and "I might collapse" stay 911.
- **B1 (same):** a client who asks "I'm not breathing properly during squats" or "I am not breathing right when I bench" gets "call 911 now". The `I'm not breathing` pattern now skips a technique question tied to an activity (the same activity list the "couldn't breathe during" pattern already uses); "I'm not breathing", "I am not breathing, help" and "I'm not breathing properly" stay 911.
- **B2 (AUDIT-05-125):** a client who types something the router does not match, such as "nobody would care if I was gone" or "I wish I could disappear forever", reaches the model with a prompt that lists mental health as out of scope and says to point to the coach, with no instruction to give 988 or 911. The client reply contract now has a "Crisis and emergencies" section: give the 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline, 911 for immediate danger, someone they trust, never only the coach; a medical emergency happening now gets 911; plain training talk is answered as usual. Anchor added to `ROMAN_CONTRACT_ANCHORS`.

## Not changed
- The self-harm list is untouched: "I want to die after these burpees" still gets the 988 template (conservative; owner decision listed in the audit report).
- "chest pain" and every "can't breathe" form stay 911, as ruled in B-758-1.

## Overlap
None with any open PR's files. Both routers share `src/ai/ai-crisis-router.ts`, so the AI guide gets the same narrowing.

 - If safety_intake.completed is false (the health questions are not answered), never suggest increasing intensity, load or volume beyond the assigned plan; suggest finishing the health questions in the consultation first.

+## Crisis and emergencies
+- Clear messages about suicide, self-harm or a medical emergency are answered before they reach you. If one reaches you anyway, even said indirectly or half as a joke (for example, that nobody would care if they were gone, that they want to disappear, or that they cannot go on), do not treat it as out of scope and do not only suggest the coach. +- Plain training talk with no sign of distress ("leg day killed me", "I felt like I was going to pass out in yesterday's class") is not a crisis: answer it as usual, with the injury or medical guidance above where it applies.

 ## Tone additions

 - Plain words at about an 8th-grade level. Lead with the answer. Default to 120 words or fewer; up to 300 only when asked for a full breakdown.
